title: Phone polish wave 3: admin tools used at the venue

criteria.text: Scores first load: tonight's date group and its first time slot are open with no tap (DateMatchGroup and TimeSlotMatchGroup open when their default turns from false to true; never close). New test file with the real components: 5 nights then only the last night; and 3 or fewer nights with more than 5 matches tonight, then only tonight; a true-to-false default stays open.
Live Corrections game card: the 'Change winner' button keeps its words inside the button at 320 and 390 px (flex-wrap on the card header, the button drops under the title); desktop unchanged.

Edit round is a bottom sheet below 768 px (ResponsiveDialog) and a centred pop-up from 768 px. A swipe cannot throw away typed changes: dismissible is true when nothing is typed and false when typed or saving; Cancel still asks 'Close and lose them?'. Own test file for dismissible; dialogs.test.tsx unchanged and passing. Browser at 390 with touch: type, swipe (stays), Cancel (asks), Save, then the page still scrolls and takes taps.

Admin sections that use AdminSectionWrapper line up with the Sections bar on a phone (no second 16 px side gutter, smaller top space below 768 px; unchanged from 768 px). Shots at 320 and 390 of Scores and the 6 setup sections that use it (no sideways scroll).

Scores: the filter tag row ('Date: ...', 'Bracket: ...') that repeats the date button and bracket select is removed (the tags had no remove buttons); Clear All Filters stays and its test still passes. The filter hint line stays visible as plain text; its tooltip (unreachable by tap) is removed and its icon is aria-hidden.

Text and controls: League Night Status chart axis labels are whole and 12 px (left margin -16 to 0); Scores score-button team labels are 12 px (text-2xs to text-xs, same 1rem line height); the 'Developer' button is at least 44 px tall. 320 and 390 scan (Scores groups open): no text under 12 px and no control under 44 px on the five Wave 3 routes.

Docs in the same change: on-a-phone.md, enter-scores-in-bulk.md and the Live Corrections, League Night Status feature docs, MODAL_PATTERNS.md (a sheet with typed input passes dismissible false while dirty, with an onOpenChange guard), UI-UX audit boxes, verification rows, the Wave 3 checklist in docs/plans/PHONE-POLISH-2026-11.md ([-] Change winner sheet, Timeslots date button, Live Corrections filters, Timeslots table moved to Wave 8), and the carried Wave 2 note (the-schedule-page.md: the carousel also moves when the selected night is pressed again; SCHED-43 re-tap step).

Before/after shots at 320, 390 and 1280 px of the five Wave 3 routes; no page scrolls sideways; no new console errors; required checks (typecheck, lint, unit, build, knip, integrity) pass on the final commit.

reviews.summary: Code correct (group open fix, Edit round sheet with vaul dismissible, flex-wrap, wrapper padding, tags, hint, chart, labels, Developer all verified). Block: two docs still say five dialogs become bottom drawers: on-a-phone.md:350 and verification/cross-cutting.md:168 (PHONE-11); Edit round is the sixth.

history.summary: QA: integrity FAIL, MassScoreEntryTool.test.tsx has 5 fewer assertions (921c703 removed the 3 filter-tag tests with the tags). Builder adds a real test of the change: with a date and a bracket set, the date button and the bracket picker still show both values and no Date:/Bracket: tag shows. No padding.
Reviewer: on-a-phone.md:350 and PHONE-11 (verification/cross-cutting.md:168) still say five dialogs; make them six with Edit round, PHONE-11 marked Changed 2026-11-10.
